data.long_meaning: AlHameedah is a name derived from the Arabic language, which is used to describe someone who is praised, glorified, and exalted. In Islamic belief, it is a name given to those who are revered and held in high esteem, reflecting the virtues of righteousness, wisdom, and peace. The name AlHameedah carries the meaning “Praised, Glorified, Exalted” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose AlHameedah usually hope their child will grow to embody praised, glorified, exalted and live with faith, good character and purpose.
